resources.string: How to detect the language of a text
By alphabet: the whole text is read with one voice
By Unicode: every piece of text in another alphabet gets its own voice

Voices of any installed speech synthesizer can be used. The rule by alphabet works for any text, the rule by language when the language is known. Each rule has its own speed and volume. A voice of another synthesizer is experimental: queued phrases may overlap.
